description:
Comfortable Power for Everyday Commuting
The Kornorge T63 Electric Bike is designed for riders who want practical electric assistance, comfortable handling, and easy everyday mobility. Its 500W motor delivers smooth acceleration with up to 75 N·m of torque, while the removable 36V 13Ah battery supports a maximum pedal-assist range of up to 50 miles under ideal riding conditions.
A front suspension fork, 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires, and front and rear disc brakes help provide stable and predictable handling across city streets, bike paths, neighborhood roads, and light gravel surfaces. A long 23.62-inch comfort seat, twist throttle, and smart LCD display make the T63 well suited to commuting, casual cruising, errands, and everyday transportation.

Why Choose the Kornorge T63 Electric Bike?

500W Motor with 75 N·m Torque
The 500W motor provides smooth and manageable electric assistance for daily commuting, neighborhood riding, and moderate inclines, with up to 75 N·m of torque for responsive acceleration.

36V 13Ah Removable Battery
The removable lithium-ion battery supports a maximum pedal-assist range of up to 50 miles under ideal conditions and can be conveniently charged on or off the bike.

20 mph Controlled Top Speed
A maximum assisted speed of up to 20 mph provides a balanced riding experience suited to commuting, neighborhood travel, bike paths, and relaxed recreational riding.

Front Suspension Comfort
The front dual suspension fork helps absorb bumps and road vibration, improving comfort and control across pavement, uneven streets, gravel paths, and park trails.

20 × 4.0 Inch Fat Tires
Wide fat tires provide a larger contact patch for improved stability, traction, and confidence across city roads, bike paths, gravel, grass, and other light mixed-terrain surfaces.

Front and Rear Disc Brakes
Disc brakes at both wheels provide dependable stopping performance for everyday city riding, neighborhood travel, and changing road conditions.

Smart LCD Display
The digital LCD display provides access to essential riding information including speed, distance, assistance level, battery status, trip data, and other ride information.

Extended 23.62-Inch Comfort Seat
The long moped-style seat provides additional seating space and support for relaxed cruising, commuting, and everyday riding.

Smart App Support
Compatible app functionality adds convenient ride-data and bike-management features for riders who want additional connected control.

Who Is the Kornorge T63 Electric Bike For?

Daily Commuters
A practical choice for riders who need comfortable electric assistance for work, school, local travel, and routine transportation.

First-Time E-Bike Riders
The manageable 20 mph top speed, smooth 500W motor, stable fat tires, and straightforward controls make the T63 approachable for riders new to electric bikes.

Neighborhood and City Riders
Well suited to neighborhood streets, urban roads, bike paths, and everyday errands where predictable handling and comfortable cruising matter more than extreme performance.

Comfort-Focused Riders
The long seat, front suspension, upright riding position, and wide tires help provide a relaxed and stable riding experience.

Light Mixed-Terrain Riders
The 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires and front suspension allow the T63 to handle pavement, gravel paths, park trails, and other light mixed surfaces with added stability.

Shorter and Medium-Height Riders
With a recommended rider height of approximately 5'2"–6'0", the T63 is designed to accommodate a broad range of smaller and medium-height adult riders.

Available Colors
Black / White / Orange / Dark Green

Maximum Range
Up to 50 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Net Weight
64.41 lb / 29.2 kg, Including Battery

Additional Equipment
Rear Light, Reflective Pedals, Kickstand, and Smart App Support

Maximum speed, range, climbing ability, and other performance figures are based on manufacturer specifications and testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, battery condition, and riding conditions.
